exposure: previous delivery at a health centre/post
use of a taxi/bus to reach a health facility
uncertainty about travel time to a health facility
cohort: The study included 562 pregnant women attending antenatal care in Eastern Province, Zambia, recruited using systematic random sampling.
finding: Adequate knowledge of obstetric danger signs was significantly associated with a history of stillbirth, previous delivery at a health centre/post, using a taxi/bus to reach a health facility, uncertainty about travel time to a health facility, and being Catholic.
